reports.title: MasterBrand Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, MasterBrand expects the following:
•Adjusted EBITDA1,2 in the range of $38 to $48 million, with related adjusted EBITDA margin1,2 in the range of 4.0% to 4.9%
•Adjusted diluted loss per share1,2 in the range of $(0.12) to $(0.08)
◦Reflects interest expense of approximately $24 million, reflecting the $375 million Term Loan A used to retire American Woodmark's debt at close
For the full year 2026, MasterBrand now expects its addressable market to be down high-single digits and assumes no improvement in demand through year-end. The Company also expects the following:
•Gross tariff costs of approximately 5-6% of full-year 2026 net sales; expected to be fully offset on a dollar-for-dollar run-rate basis by end of year
•Free cash flow1 for full-year 2026 expected to be approximately breakeven

This outlook reflects the combined company, includes the $1.3 million of IEEPA duty refunds received in the fourth quarter and continued synergy realization, and supersedes the second-half 2026 outlook previously provided by the Company. MasterBrand now expects second-half 2026 cost synergies to exceed its previously communicated target of approximately $15 million.

This financial outlook only reflects the impact of those tariffs in effect as of the date of this release and does not reflect any other potential tariffs or tariff-related impacts on company costs or end market demand. The Company believes the dynamic nature of tariffs, specifically the uncertainty of implementation, potential timing and duration, limits the usefulness of estimating this information. MasterBrand undertakes no obligation to update this outlook as circumstances evolve.
1 - See "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" and the corresponding financial tables at the end of this press release for definitions and reconciliations of non-GAAP measures.
